For a fast-growing manufacturing company, we are looking for a hands-on ERP Application Manager. 
The group will implement a new ERP package (MS Dynamics F&O) and want to attract someone who will lead this project.
 

In this key role, the application manager will act as the bridge between the needs of their business departments and the ERP solution, ensuring seamless implementation across the organization.
 

This is a job on-site in Tournai with travel to their production site in France from time to time.
 

Functie
 
 

• Understand and analyze the current systems (own build applications) to identify opportunities for improvement. 

• Collaborate with departments (production, logistics, finance, etc.) to gather their needs and ensure they are reflected in the ERP system. 

• Lead the ERP implementation, introducing modules step by step while ensuring strong alignment across internal teams. 

• Direct the software partner and other external consultants. 

• Evaluate and optimize current processes to improve efficiency, standardization, and flexibility. 

• Identify custom needs and differentiate ERP functions from other tools (e.g., WMS, MES, BI). 

• You give support and training to the users. 

• Define user roles and access levels, as well as onboarding procedures for new employees. 
 

• At least 3 years of experience implementing ERP systems (SAP, D365, or equivalent). 

• A solid understanding of software environments (ERP, WMS, CMMS, MES, CRM, HR systems). 

• Experience in the food industry or knowledge of traceability systems (a plus). 

• Project management expertise: Familiarity with principles and methodologies to manage ERP rollout projects. 

• Strong problem-solving skills to handle technical challenges quickly and effectively. 

• Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. 

• A detail-oriented mindset to ensure system accuracy and data integrity.  
 

• You’re independent, a great team player, and excel in building connections. 

• Dynamic, proactive and curious. 

• Fluency in English. Knowledge of French and Dutch is a plus.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a Field Service Technician for a company located in Zaventem. 
Your responsibilities 

 
• You install, repair and maintain garage doors, fences, barriers and related equipment. 
 

 
• You work independently or as part of a team at customer sites. 
 

 
• You ensure high-quality service and customer satisfaction at all times. 

You hold a degree in electronics/electrical engineering with mechanical knowledge, or a degree in electromechanics. 
You speak English. Knowledge of Dutch and/or French are considered as an asset! You have at least 3 years of experience as a door installer. 
You possess a valid category B driving licence. 
You are customer-focused and committed to delivering quality work.

• Flexible hours – work 2 days a week (but NOT Wednesdays—those are for all the other fun stuff you’re doing! ).

• Help with labeling, wrapping, packing and preparing orders using a scanning system.

• Get hands-on with the latest logistics tech and industry best practices.

• Become a logistics pro and make a real impact at one of Belgium’s largest port companies!

• You’re comfortable working independently and taking initiative.

• You must be available to work at least two days a week, from Monday to Friday.

• You’re a full-time student at a college or university in Belgium.

• Most importantly, you’re highly motivated and ready to roll up your sleeves!

• You speak English and/or Dutch fluently.

• You value safety and take responsibility seriously in your work.

Are you detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working in a dynamic international environment?

We are looking for a Contract & Order Management Officer to support the commercial operations and ensure the seamless handling of contracts, quotations, and purchase orders.

As part of the team, you will play a key role in supporting the end-to-end contract and order management process by:

• Managing business contracts, including approval workflows and electronic signatures.

• Preparing and processing quotations while helping to standardize and optimize existing processes.

• Reviewing purchase orders for completeness, consistency, and accuracy, and ensuring timely processing and communication.

• Building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders through proactive communication on contract and order status.

• Developing expertise in the business you support, including customer requirements, contractual frameworks, and quotation processes.

• 3 to 5 years of experience in a medium-sized to large organization or a complex business environment.

• Initial experience in contract management, sales administration/support, or a paralegal role.

• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a focus on quality and accuracy.

• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving work environment.

• Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

• Tech-savvy, with experience using tools such as Microsoft Office, MS Dynamics CRM, and OneDrive.

• Fluent in English

Are you a natural communicator who enjoys solving problems and making customers feel heard? Do you speak fluent English and Spanish? Then this Customer Service Representative role in the life sciences sector may be your next step.

As Customer Service Representative, you are the first point of contact for customers and the link between them and the teams working behind the scenes. You listen, work out what is needed, and make sure it gets sorted quickly and properly.

What you will do

• Handle customer questions by phone and in writing: orders, billing, cancellations, account queries, complaints and errors

• Welcome customers warmly, understand their issue and either resolve it yourself or route it to the right colleague

• Take in and process orders, and arrange refunds and exchanges where needed

• Create and maintain customer accounts with accurate, up-to-date information

• Support shipping and transport documentation and answer related questions

• Log and follow up on service requests

• Help coordinate product recalls when they occur

• Spot customer needs and share ideas for relevant products or services with management

• Work closely with the commercial team, logistics, Finance, Quality, Regulatory and Legal

As a Customer Service Representative you should have the following characteristics:

• A bachelor’s degree in languages or economics, or equivalent knowledge gained through experience or training

• At least 3 years of experience in a comparable customer service or order management role within an international sales organisation. Experience in medical devices or life sciences is a clear advantage

• Fluent English and Spanish, spoken and written. Dutch or other European languages are a plus

• Solid knowledge of the order process, and hands-on experience with an ERP system (e.g. Microsoft Dynamics AX)

• Good command of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

• Strong telephone skills and a real talent for listening

• An analytical and organised way of working, with careful documentation

• The ability to juggle several tasks, stay calm in a fast-changing environment and handle conflicts constructively

• Good interpersonal skills and the confidence to make an impact

Nice to haves

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Knowledge of how to use artificial intelligence in your daily work

As a Production Shift Supervisor, you are responsible for the daily operations of a modern packaging and production department. You lead a team of approximately 150 employees across multiple packaging lines and ensure that production targets, quality standards and customer requirements are achieved efficiently and safely.

You are a visible leader on the shop floor, coaching and supporting your team while continuously looking for opportunities to improve processes, efficiency and performance.

What will you do?

• Lead and support a large operational team, including direct supervision of team leaders.
• Monitor production planning, quality, safety and productivity targets.
• Coordinate closely with planning, logistics and maintenance teams to ensure smooth daily operations.
• Follow up on employee performance, coaching and development.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies.
• Ensure products meet the highest quality standards and customer expectations.

Who are you?

• You have experience in a supervisory role within a production, packaging or food manufacturing environment.
• You are a strong people manager who can motivate, coach and develop teams.
• You remain calm under pressure and can effectively prioritize in a dynamic environment.
• You have an interest in production processes and a willingness to develop your technical knowledge.
• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English; knowledge of Romanian is an asset.
• You are quality-focused, hands-on and solution-oriented.
• You understand the flexibility required in a fresh food environment where quality and customer service are key.

Do you have hands-on production planning experience and practical knowledge of ERP and Excel? Join us as a Production Planner. Apply today!As a production planner, you coordinate the planning process from the arrival of machines and parts through assembly, technical checks and final delivery to the customer. 
• You plan and coordinate the process from incoming machines and parts to final delivery. 
• You ensure that parts, assembly activities and technical checks are scheduled correctly. 
• You monitor progress and adjust the production schedule when needed. 
• You coordinate closely with Supply Chain Management, the technical team and Sales. 
• You identify bottlenecks and help optimize production flow and capacity. 
• You accurately register incoming equipment and related information in the system.
What are we looking for in you? 
• You have relevant experience in production planning or a similar role. 
• You have hands-on experience with SAP or another ERP system. Theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient. 
• You are proficient in MS Office, particularly Excel. 
• You have sufficient English skills for daily communication with colleagues and other departments.

Do you love turning a phone call into a lasting customer relationship? As an Inside Sales Account Manager in Tienen, you win over Polish customers and help their business grow. Apply for this job today!
 

You mix hunting for new customers with looking after existing accounts. Your tasks as an Inside Sales Account Manager will be: 
 

 
• You onboard Polish customers and win back inactive accounts.
 
• You recruit new traders and dealers from incoming calls or from a database.
 
• You nurture the relationships in your portfolio so their business grows togheter with the company. Once a year, you visit a selected group of customers with a commercial manager.
 
• You present and demo our sales solutions to buyers and sellers, and run call campaigns to launch new solutions, products and services.
 
• You follow up and report on market trends and performance in your territory, to boost sales and grow the company's market share. 

Does this sound like you?
 

 
• You speak English and Polish fluently. Another language is a plus.
 
• You have 1 to 5 years of experience in inside sales or a similar commercial role.
 
• You have strong sales and negotiation skills, and you love the exitment of closing deals.
 
• You explain your ideas clearly, in speech and in writing, and you feel comfortable selling by phone.
 
• You work towards sales targets and aim to beat them. You stay positive under pressure and keep learning.

Are you a skilled driver who keeps a warehouse running without a hitch? For a logistics company in Geel, we are looking for a Forklift & Reach Truck Driver (2 shifts) who enjoys variety, pace, and accurate work. In this role, you steer smoothly through the aisles to place pallets in the right spots and lend a hand on the warehouse floor.
 

 
 

Ready for a secure job with great pay? Read on!
 

 
 

Interested? Apply using the button, call 011 54 92 85, or send a message with your CV to talentcenter4@randstad.be.
 

VG 458/BUOSAP
 

 

We are looking for the following profile:
 
 

• You hold valid licenses for both forklift and reach truck. Plenty of experience but missing the actual paper? We are glad to look at training options to get you certified! 

• You easily speak and understand Dutch or English. Clear communication is essential for safety rules and staying in sync with your crew. 

• You like variety in your day (balancing vehicle work with floor tasks) and are ready to pitch in on a night or weekend shift during busy peak periods like the holidays. 

• You have your own reliable ride to commute to our site in Geel.  

 
 

Your daily routine:
 
 

• Operating your forklift or reach truck, you smoothly place pallets into high rack storage and keep stock levels topped up. 

• You won't just be behind the wheel all day. You frequently step out of the cabin to pick orders using a barcode scanner. 

• Manually moving, stacking, and unloading boxes is no issue for you. You are physically active, reliable, and ready to roll up your sleeves.

Do you want to work as a warehouse worker at Kuehne+Nagel in Geel either in 2 shifts, or on a fixed early or late shift for a great hourly wage of €15.65 gross? This is your chance! For a temporary 2-week assignment during the busy Sinterklaas and Christmas period, you will play an indispensable role in getting all parcels ready for shipment on time.
 

 
 

Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and making sure everything goes out the door smoothly? Then this is the job for you! You will step into a varied and active role where time flies and your effort truly counts. 
 

 
 

Interested? Send your CV straight away to talentcenter1@randstad.be, apply via the 'apply' button, or call us on 011 54 92 85!
 

 
 

VG 458/BUOSAP
 

 

 

• Good command of Dutch or English. 

• Willing to work in 2 shifts (if you are only available for the early or late shift, this is definitely an option too). 

• You are available for two weeks starting from 23/11. 

• Availability on Saturday or Sunday is a plus, not a must. 

• In possession of your own transport (car, bicycle...) to easily reach Kuehne+Nagel in Geel.  

 
 
 

• Accurately sorting and neatly packing products to high quality standards. 

• Applying the correct shipping labels and stickers to boxes.
